overallNotes: Batch 1 covers Section 6.01(a) (the core incurrence prohibition and the ratio-based permitted-incurrence proviso with its three security-classification conditions and nested greater-of/lesser-of ratio alternatives, culminating in the defined term 'Permitted Ratio Debt') and the start of Section 6.01(b) (carve-outs (1) Loan Documents/ABL/Fixed Incremental Amount, (2) Reserved, (3) Existing Indebtedness, and the beginning of (4) the capital-expenditure/purchase-money basket with its three-part aggregate cap formula).

The cross-reference 'Section 6.01(b)(1)' appears twice in the provided text with materially different content (once defining the ABL/Loan Documents exception itself in slot 6.01(b)(1), and once as a carve-out reference inside the Existing Indebtedness exception in slot 6.01(b)(3)); which occurrence a further reference points to is genuinely ambiguous and was not guessed.

References to Section 2.18, Section 6.08(a)(3)(b), Section 6.08(b) and Section 6.08(b)(4) could not be expanded due to source-context budget exhaustion; only Section 2.18 (with 2.19/2.22) appears within the provided slots and was inventoried as an unresolved REFERENCE.
Exception (2) under Section 6.01(b) is marked [Reserved] and carries no substantive/operative content.

The final slot of the batch (6.01(b)(4)(a)(iii)#1) ends mid-clause introducing a new exception '(b) Indebtedness in the form of', which is truncated at the batch boundary; its materiality and scope cannot be assessed from the text provided.

The $360.0 million / 50% of Consolidated EBITDA cap (component (i) of the Section 6.01(b)(4) exception) is treated as a SHARED_CAP because it is drawn upon jointly by original Indebtedness/Disqualified Stock/Preferred Stock and by Refinancing Indebtedness incurred in respect thereof, per the aggregation language in slot 6.01(b)(4)(a)#5.
